short_description: Minimize memory load. Make objects, actions, and options visible or easily retrievable.

positive.definition: Icon-only controls have visible labels or text alternates (sidebar, toolbar)
positive.evidence_required: name the control and the label

positive.definition: Recent items, frequent items, or history is surfaced (recent files, recent searches)
positive.evidence_required: name the surface and the recents source

positive.definition: Search and entry fields offer autocomplete or live suggestions
positive.evidence_required: name the field and the suggestion mechanism

positive.definition: Tooltips, inline hints, or examples appear near the controls they explain
positive.evidence_required: name the control and the hint

positive.definition: Buttons and actions are named for what they do, not vague verbs (Save Changes, Send Invite vs Submit, Go)

negative.definition: Sidebar or main nav uses icons only with no labels and no tooltips
negative.evidence_required: name the nav and what is missing

negative.definition: Useful feature requires the user to remember a hidden command or path
negative.evidence_required: name the feature and how it is reached

negative.definition: Frequent task surface (recent files, recent searches) is absent where users would expect it
negative.evidence_required: name the surface and the missing affordance

negative.definition: Buttons use vague verbs (Submit, Go, OK) with no context about what they do
negative.evidence_required: name the button and the surrounding context

negative.definition: Search field has no autocomplete or recent searches, requiring users to recall exact terms

critical_negative.definition: Surface requires memorizing commands or syntax with zero affordances for discovery
